import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { FormBuilder, FormGroup, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms'; @Component({ selector: 'app-inquiry-form', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule], template: `
Inquire Now

Project Inquiry Form

Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

Contact Information

Project Details

Existing Website

Required Features *

Design Style Preference

Branding & Content

Reference Websites (optional)

Special Requirements or Concerns

How did you hear about Chapadevs?

Additional Comments

`, styles: [` .inquiry-section { background: #fff; padding: 80px 0; } .inquiry-form { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; background: #f9fafb; padding: 2.5rem; border-radius: 16px; } .form-section { margin-bottom: 2.5rem; } .form-row { display: flex; gap: 2rem; } .form-group { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } label { font-weight: 600; color: #1f2937; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } input, select, textarea { padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; background: #fff; transition: border-color 0.3s; } input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: #10b981; } .checkbox-group { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem; } .form-actions { text-align: center; margin-top: 2rem; } .btn-primary { background: #10b981; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 50px; padding: 1rem 2.5rem; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s; } .btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .form-row { flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; } .inquiry-form { padding: 1.5rem; } } `] }) export class InquiryFormComponent { inquiryForm: FormGroup; goalsList = [ 'Increase online presence', 'Generate leads/sales', 'Showcase portfolio/services', 'Sell products online', 'Improve user experience', 'Mobile optimization', 'SEO improvement' ]; featuresList = [ 'Contact forms', 'Online booking/scheduling', 'Payment processing', 'User accounts/login', 'Blog/news section', 'Photo galleries', 'Social media integration', 'Email newsletter signup', 'Search functionality', 'Multi-language support', 'Analytics tracking' ]; designStylesList = [ 'Modern/minimalist', 'Creative/artistic', 'Professional/corporate', 'Playful/colorful', 'Industry-specific design', 'Not sure - need guidance' ]; constructor(private fb: FormBuilder) { this.inquiryForm = this.fb.group({ name: ['', Validators.required], email: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email]], company: [''], phone: [''], contactMethod: ['', Validators.required], projectType: ['', Validators.required], description: ['', Validators.required], goals: [[]], goalOther: [''], budget: ['', Validators.required], launchDate: ['', Validators.required], hasWebsite: ['', Validators.required], websiteUrl: [''], currentHost: [''], features: [[]], featureOther: [''], designStyles: [[]], branding: ['', Validators.required], brandingDetails: [''], contentStatus: ['', Validators.required], referenceWebsites: [''], specialRequirements: [''], hearAboutUs: [''], additionalComments: [''] }); } onGoalChange(event: any) { const goals = this.inquiryForm.value.goals as string[]; if (event.target.checked) { this.inquiryForm.patchValue({ goals: [...goals, event.target.value] }); } else { this.inquiryForm.patchValue({ goals: goals.filter(g => g !== event.target.value) }); } } onFeatureChange(event: any) { const features = this.inquiryForm.value.features as string[]; if (event.target.checked) { this.inquiryForm.patchValue({ features: [...features, event.target.value] }); } else { this.inquiryForm.patchValue({ features: features.filter(f => f !== event.target.value) }); } } onStyleChange(event: any) { const styles = this.inquiryForm.value.designStyles as string[]; if (event.target.checked) { this.inquiryForm.patchValue({ designStyles: [...styles, event.target.value] }); } else { this.inquiryForm.patchValue({ designStyles: styles.filter(s => s !== event.target.value) }); } } onSubmit() { if (this.inquiryForm.valid) { // TODO: Integrate with backend/email service alert('Inquiry submitted!'); this.inquiryForm.reset(); } } }
